doc: CONTENT half of the primary-tool-search guard (engine-content separation is mandatory for federation-grade gate primitives). The ENGINE is hooks/primary-tool-search-guard.py; tool names + lite-specs live HERE and may evolve without touching the automaton. Sibling to tool-absence-claim-lexicon.json (the WRITE-boundary guard); this guard fires EARLIER, at the ToolSearch call, before the false 'not-found' signal can form. Occurrence history: feedback_agent-tool-presence-probe #1-#9. A ToolSearch searches ONLY the DEFERRED registry; a PRIMARY (top-level) tool is never in it, so a no-match for a primary tool is EXPECTED and is not evidence that it is unreachable.

classes.reliably_primary: Top-level in Claude Code by design — essentially never deferred. ToolSearch will not return it; a no-match is expected and means 'already available', not 'unreachable'. Invoke it directly.
classes.usually_primary_session_variable: Usually top-level, but MAY be moved to the deferred registry in a given session. If ToolSearch DID return it, use it from there; if it returned nothing, it is primary this session — invoke it directly. Either way it is reachable.

Agent.lite_spec: Spawn a subagent / delegate a task or broad search. subagent_type picks the agent (fork inherits your full context; other/omitted = fresh). The agent's final message returns as the tool result. Runs in background when subagent_type is a custom agent.

Task.lite_spec: Legacy name for Agent (renamed in Claude Code 2.1.63). Use Agent. Never in the deferred registry.

Bash.lite_spec: Run a shell command. Supports run_in_background + timeout. Prefer dedicated file/search tools where one fits.

Read.lite_spec: Read a file (text, images, PDF pages, notebooks) with line numbers. offset/limit for large files.

Edit.lite_spec: Exact string replacement in a file you have Read this session. replace_all for every occurrence.

Write.lite_spec: Create or fully overwrite a file (must have Read an existing target first).

Skill.lite_spec: Invoke a skill by name (the /slash-commands). Only invoke skills in the available-skills list.

Workflow.lite_spec: Run a deterministic multi-agent orchestration script (opt-in / ultracode only). Fan-out, pipeline, verify.

Artifact.lite_spec: Publish an HTML/Markdown file as a hosted, default-private artifact page. Load the artifact-design skill first.

AskUserQuestion.lite_spec: Ask the user a blocking decision that is genuinely theirs (1-4 questions, 2-4 options each).

ScheduleWakeup.lite_spec: Schedule when to resume a /loop dynamic-mode iteration (delaySeconds, reason, prompt).

ReportFindings.lite_spec: Report code-review findings as a typed list (only when the review instructions ask for it).

ToolSearch.lite_spec: Fetch schemas for DEFERRED tools so they become callable. Searches the deferred registry ONLY — it cannot return a primary tool (this guard).

Glob.lite_spec: Fast filename/path glob matching. Often primary; may be deferred in some sessions.

Grep.lite_spec: Ripgrep content search. Often primary; may be deferred in some sessions.

TodoWrite.lite_spec: Session todo list. Session-variable; in this federation the Task* tools (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskList) are the tracked equivalent.

NotebookEdit.lite_spec: Edit a Jupyter notebook cell. Session-variable.
